title: Many devices were enrolled outside Autopilot

maxPct.text: Share enrolled outside Autopilot before provisioning consistency suffers

report.title: {Items.Count} Windows {Plural(Items.Count, 'device was', 'devices were')} not provisioned through Autopilot

messages.businessImpact: Devices built by hand differ from each other in ways nobody records, which is where most unexplained support cases begin.
remediation: Register new hardware with Autopilot at the point of purchase, through the supplier where possible.
messages.cannotSee: An Autopilot registration and an enrolment are matched by identifier, so hardware registered after it enrolled counts against the tenant here, and a device provisioned through Autopilot whose registration has since been deleted does too.
